```{r}
overlapSums <- function(x, y, z, na.rm=FALSE) {
  stopifnot(class(x)=="GRanges")
  stopifnot(class(y)=="GRanges")
  stopifnot(class(z)=="numeric" | class(z)=="integer")
  stopifnot(length(x)==length(z))
  ov <- as.matrix(findOverlaps(y, x))
  ovSums <- rep(as.numeric(NA), length(y))
  ovSums[unique(ov[,1])] <- viewSums(Views(z[ov[,2]], ranges(Rle(ov[,1]))), na.rm=na.rm)
  ovSums
}


overlapRatios <- function(x, y, C, cov, minCov, na.rm=FALSE) {
  C.sum <- overlapSums(x, y, values(x)[[C]], na.rm=na.rm)
  cov.sum <- overlapSums(x, y, values(x)[[cov]], na.rm=na.rm)
  ov_all <- as.data.frame(findOverlaps(y, x)) 
  number_of_CpGs <- rle(ov_all[,1])$lengths #--- total number of CpGs per region
  CpG_ov_regions <- x[ov_all$subjectHits] #--- coverage of CpGs overlapping regions
  ov_all$cov <- as.numeric(values(CpG_ov_regions)[[cov]])
  ov_all$cov_binary<-as.numeric(ifelse(ov_all$cov>=minCov, 1, 0))
  number_of_CpGs_minCov <- as.numeric(tapply(ov_all$cov_binary, ov_all$queryHits, FUN=sum))
  CpGs_covered <- as.numeric(number_of_CpGs_minCov) / as.numeric(number_of_CpGs)
  rat <- as.data.frame(C.sum/cov.sum)
  rat_cov<-cbind(rat, CpGs_covered)
  colnames(rat_cov) <- c("rat", "CpGs_covered")
  rat_cov$rat[rat_cov$CpGs_covered < 0.5] <- NA
  rat_cov[,1]
}
```

#background CpGs
```{r}
# Define chromosomes to keep
keep_chrs <- paste0("chr", c(1:6, "X", "Y"))

# Filter CpG object
CpG_sc <- CpG[seqnames(CpG) %in% keep_chrs]

#select rows with median coverage >=3
# Get coverage column names
cov_cols <- grep("\\.cov$", colnames(mcols(CpG_sc)), value = TRUE)

# Calculate median coverage for each row
median_cov <- apply(mcols(CpG_sc)[, cov_cols], 1, median, na.rm = TRUE)

# Add median coverage as metadata column
mcols(CpG_sc)$median_cov <- median_cov

# Filter for median coverage >= 3
CpG_filt <- CpG_sc[CpG_sc$median_cov >= 3]

```

```{r}
module load centos7.8/phuluu/R/4.0.3
library(rtracklayer)
library(data.table)
x <- import("/share/ScratchGeneral/kseskv/annotateBed/invariant_ext100_l500_cpg3_NUMBER.bed")

annot <- fread("/share/ScratchGeneral/kseskv/annotateBed/dunnart_male_T2T_embryo_invariant_reg_annotation_genes.txt", fill=TRUE)
annot <- as.data.frame(annot)
cnames <- colnames(annot)[7:(ncol(annot))]
annot <- annot[, c(4, 7:ncol(annot))]
colnames(annot) <- c("id", cnames)



#--- Regions to test
#test.ids <- read.table(test.file, sep="\t", check.names=FALSE)[,1]
test.ids <- x$name
#test.ids <- hypo_e72_atf$name
test.idxs <- match(test.ids, annot$id)

#--- Regions to use as backgorund
#background.ids <- read.table(background.file, sep="\t", check.names=FALSE)[,1]
#background.idxs <- match(background.ids, annot[,1])
background.idxs <- 1:nrow(annot)

#--- Compute annotation enrichments
n.test <- c()
n.background <- c()
p <- c()
annot.idxs.list <- list(tss = grep("promoters", colnames(annot)),
                        promoters = grep("genes", colnames(annot)),
                        genes = grep("exons", colnames(annot)),
                        exons = grep("introns", colnames(annot)),
                        introns = grep("intergenic", colnames(annot)),
                        intergenic = grep("repeats", colnames(annot)))                     
for (annot.idxs in annot.idxs.list) {
  # test regions
  temp <- apply(annot[test.idxs, annot.idxs, drop=FALSE], 1, max)
  temp[temp == 0] <- 0.001 # takes care of regions not ping any annotations
  I.test <- (annot[test.idxs, annot.idxs, drop=FALSE] >= temp) # which annotation best s the region?
  I.test <- I.test/(rowSums(I.test)+1e-16) # account for ties
  
  # background regions
  temp <- apply(annot[background.idxs, annot.idxs, drop=FALSE], 1, max)
  temp[temp == 0] <- 0.001 # takes care of regions not ping any annotations
  I.background <- (annot[background.idxs, annot.idxs, drop=FALSE] >= temp) # which annotation best overlaps the region?
  I.background <- I.background/(rowSums(I.background)+1e-16) # account for ties
  
  k <- nrow(I.test)
  M <- nrow(I.background)
  
  for (i in 1:ncol(I.test)){
    q <- ceiling(sum(I.test[,i]))
    m <- ceiling(sum(I.background[,i]))
    pval <- min(phyper(q, m, M-m, k, lower.tail=TRUE),
                phyper(q, m, M-m, k, lower.tail=FALSE))
    n.test <- c(n.test, q)
    n.background <- c(n.background, m)
    p <- c(p, pval)
  }  
}
f.test <- n.test/k; f.background <- n.background/M; e <- f.test/f.background
rv <- cbind(n.test, n.background, f.test, f.background, e, p)
rownames(rv) <- colnames(annot)[unlist(annot.idxs.list)]
colnames(rv) <- c("n.test", "n.background", "f.test", "f.background",  "enrichment", "p-value")
rv <- as.data.frame(rv)
rv$qval <- p.adjust(rv$`p-value`, method = "fdr")

setwd("/share/ScratchGeneral/kseskv/annotateBed/")
write.csv(rv, "/share/ScratchGeneral/kseskv/annotateBed//invariant_ext100_l500_cpg3_NUMBER_annotation.csv")

rv <- fread("/share/ScratchGeneral/kseskv/annotateBed//invariant_ext100_l500_cpg3_NUMBER_annotation.csv")


rv_filt<-as.data.frame(rv)
rv_filt$group<-rownames(rv_filt)
rv_filt_cut<-rv_filt[,c(1,6)]
rv_filt_cut$V1<-factor(rv_filt_cut$V1, levels=unique(rv_filt_cut$V1))


setwd("/share/ScratchGeneral/kseskv/annotateBed/")
pdf("dunnart_embryo_invariant_ext100_l500_cpg3_annot.pdf", useDingbats=FALSE, width=13, height=10) 
print(ggplot(rv_filt_cut, aes(x=V1, y=enrichment, fill=V1)) +
        geom_bar(stat="identity", width=0.3) +
        ylim(0, 11.5) +
        scale_fill_manual(values=c("#F2300F",   "#35274A" , "#74A089", "#E1BD6D",  "#9A8822", "#F2300F",   "#35274A" , "#74A089", "#E1BD6D",  "#9A8822")))
```
